# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `config/agent-context.json`. Run
`node scripts/validate-agent-context.mjs` before editing, continue the current
GitHub issue and pull request, and fail closed to `needs-routing` when ownership
is unknown.

No personal approval gates: automated checks are the only gate. Never hold work,
a pull request, or a document waiting for a named collaborator to approve it
(see "No personal approval gates" in `AGENTS.md`).
